name: Hold Up narrator
note: The channel's default narrator: the owner's own cloned voice, generated locally for free. Stories without their own voice use this profile once it is approved. It stays unselected until the owner records a reference, listens to the auditions and picks one (node tools/narration/audition.mjs select <n> --by "<name>").

target.summary: An entertaining person telling an incredible story to a friend.
want: the owner's own voice, cloned locally
slightly sarcastic or amused when it fits
shifts between suspense, humour and surprise
